title: Meet the rook
objectives: Understand that the rook moves in straight lines, any distance

steps.text: The rook moves in straight lines — forward, backward, left, or right — as far as it likes, as long as nothing blocks it.

steps.prompt: Move the rook to a legal destination — any distance along its rank or file.

hints.text: Move the rook as far as it can go in one straight line.
Try moving it all the way up the board.
The rook can slide from e4 to e8 — a straight line, all the way.

feedback.default: The rook can't move diagonally. Keep it on the same rank or file.

steps.successExplanation: That's a legal rook move — straight along the e-file, with nothing in the way.

steps.prompt: Move the rook to capture the black pawn blocking its path.

hints.text: There's a black pawn in the rook's path. What can the rook do about it?
Rooks can capture pieces in their path.
The rook captures the pawn on d4.

feedback.default: The rook can't jump over the pawn — it has to stop when something blocks its path, or capture it if that something is an enemy piece.

steps.successExplanation: Rxd4 captures the pawn. The rook slides along the rank and stops exactly on the first piece in its path.
